ideas.title: Following the Money: A Deep Dive into the DOJ Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial transactions and potential corruption that led to the DOJ investigation into the Minnesota governor and mayor.
questions: What financial transactions are at the center of the investigation?
How did the governor and mayor respond to allegations of obstruction?
ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe that following the money will be key to uncovering the truth behind the DOJ investigation. By analyzing financial transactions and potential corruption, we can gain a deeper understanding of the events that led to the investigation.
